prompt:
Style: one wide panel from a European clear-line comic album of the 1960s (ligne claire), redrawn as a game background. Technique: clean black ink outlines of one constant, uniform thickness around every shape, drawn with a technical pen; no hatching, no cross-hatching, no stippling, no texture strokes, no line-weight variation, no sketchy lines. Colour: flat, solid printed colour fills inside the outlines, like flat tints in offset printing; no gradients, no airbrush, no soft shading, no glow, almost no shadows (at most one flat darker tint on a side). Drawing: very clear, precise and detailed architecture and objects, every element readable: the individual stones of the quay, the planks of the jetty, roof slates, barrel hoops, the rope coil, the planks and rails of the boats, the rocks of the headland; everything equally sharp from foreground to background, no depth blur, no atmospheric haze. The dusk mood comes only from flat colours: the sky in four flat horizontal bands from deep blue at the top through violet and pink to a flat orange band at the horizon, clouds as flat shapes with clean outlines, a few small stars; the sea as flat blue-grey with a few short drawn horizontal wave lines. Calm, balanced composition, straight horizon, eye-level view from the quay. Not a painting, not a watercolour, not a 3D render, not a photograph, not anime, not a sketch.

Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.

Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.

Layout for a game screen: horizon at about 45 % of the image height. The flat paved quay fills the bottom quarter of the image across the whole width and stays empty in the middle, so that a character can walk across it from left to right. The cottage takes the left fifth of the picture, the lighthouse on its headland the right quarter, with the lighthouse standing at about 80 % of the width; the lantern post stands on the quay a little left of the centre; barrels and crates stand at the back edge of the quay, not in the middle. Keep the upper left part of the sky simple and calm. Keep all important elements between 8 % and 92 % of the image height. Animated effects are added later as separate layers: draw the lighthouse lamp only as a small flat yellow spot without any beam, rays or glow, the lantern and the window as flat yellow without glow, the chimney without smoke, and no birds.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films. No panel border, no frame, no speech balloons.

Image format: landscape 3:2.
